name: realtime-tex-enhanced
description: Sharp live LaTeX preview with a bundled, version-pinned enhanced rtex engine. Apple Silicon Mac.

commands.title: Open Live Preview to the Side

realtimeTex.serverPath.markdownDescription: Legacy setting, retained for migration and ignored. This extension always uses its verified bundled enhanced engine and complete matching support files.
realtimeTex.serverPath.markdownDeprecationMessage: Engine selection is fixed to the verified bundled enhanced engine. Existing paths are ignored.

realtimeTex.texliveBin.markdownDescription: Folder that contains `lualatex` (TeX Live 2026+ recommended; local regressions also tested on 2025). Leave empty to use your `PATH`. Example: `/Library/TeX/texbin`.

realtimeTex.texDir.markdownDescription: Legacy setting, retained for migration and ignored. The bundled engine always uses its complete matching support files.
realtimeTex.texDir.markdownDeprecationMessage: The support directory is fixed to the verified files paired with the bundled engine. Existing paths are ignored.

enumDescriptions: Use the enhanced engine included in this extension; no engine downloads or Rust installation required
realtimeTex.installFrom.markdownDescription: The enhanced engine and matching support files are shipped together. Legacy release/source settings are ignored. [Verify bundled engine](command:realtimeTex.installRtex)

enumDescriptions: Engine updates are delivered only with a new enhanced extension installer
realtimeTex.updateCheck.markdownDescription: Independent distribution: no upstream engine checks, downloads, source pulls or automatic engine updates. Install a newer enhanced VSIX to update the plugin and engine together. Legacy notify/auto settings are ignored.

enumDescriptions: Typeset a part live when its live result matched the last full compile, whatever commands it uses (rtex's default)
Typeset live only parts made of commands rtex knows to be safe
realtimeTex.engine.eligibility.markdownDescription: How the bundled engine decides which parts can update live. See the [live editing guide](https://github.com/hengmamath/realtime-tex-vsc-plugin-personal-version/blob/main/vendor/engine/docs/live-editing.md). Changing it restarts the engine.

realtimeTex.engine.fastBudgetMs.markdownDescription: Time budget, in milliseconds, for re-typesetting one part live. A part that takes longer three times in a row waits for the full compile until the next layout. Raise it on a slow computer. Changing it restarts the engine.

realtimeTex.engine.pictureCache.markdownDescription: Reuse unchanged TikZ pictures from the previous full compile, which makes full compiles of drawing-heavy documents several times faster. Changing it restarts the engine.

realtimeTex.mainFile.markdownDescription: Main `.tex` file of the project, relative to the workspace folder. Leave empty to detect it automatically (from a `% !TEX root = …` comment or the file containing `\documentclass`).

realtimeTex.buildDir.markdownDescription: Where rtex keeps its build files. Leave empty to keep them out of your project (in VS Code's workspace storage).

realtimeTex.exportPath.markdownDescription: Where **Export PDF** writes the PDF. `${mainDir}` is the folder of the main file, `${mainName}` its name without extension.

realtimeTex.autoStart.markdownDescription: Start the engine as soon as a LaTeX file is opened, without waiting for the preview to be opened.

realtimeTex.syncCursor.markdownDescription: Legacy follow preference. When Follow Cursor has not been explicitly configured, false keeps automatic source navigation off; true uses the new Double Click default.
realtimeTex.syncCursor.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `realtimeTex.followCursor` to choose Single Click, Double Click, or Off. Existing false values remain respected until a mode is explicitly chosen.

enumDescriptions: Single-click the source to reveal and highlight its position in the preview
Double-click a source word to reveal and highlight its position in the preview
Source clicks do not move the preview; Show Cursor Position in Preview remains available
realtimeTex.followCursor.markdownDescription: Choose how clicks in the source reveal and highlight the corresponding preview line. Also available from the preview toolbar’s **Follow cursor** menu. Keyboard movement and typing do not move the preview.

realtimeTex.editor.liveMarkers.markdownDescription: Mark each part of the source next to the line numbers while the preview runs: a **solid green bar** means the part updates live as you type, a **dotted amber bar** means it waits for the full compile (the preamble, TikZ, …). Hover over a marked part that went to the full compile to see why.

realtimeTex.preview.invertInDarkTheme.markdownDescription: Show pages with dark background and light text when VS Code uses a dark theme.

enumDescriptions: Fit the page width to the preview panel

realtimeTex.stopWhenPreviewCloses.markdownDescription: Stop the engine when the preview is closed (frees memory). Turn off to keep diagnostics updating without a preview.

realtimeTex.debug.enabled.markdownDescription: Save a local debug bundle on live-engine failure (source, context, trace and TeX log). Bundles stay in local storage and are not uploaded. Changing it restarts the engine. [Open debug folder](command:realtimeTex.openDebugFolder)

realtimeTex.debug.directory.markdownDescription: Where debug bundles go. Leave empty to use the extension's storage folder ([Open debug folder](command:realtimeTex.openDebugFolder)).

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Realtime TeX Enhanced
walkthroughs.description: Sharp live LaTeX preview with a matching, bundled engine.

steps.title: Check your setup
steps.description:
This release supports **Apple Silicon Mac (M series)** and needs **LuaLaTeX** (TeX Live 2026+ recommended; also regression-tested on TeX Live 2025). The enhanced rtex engine is included.
[Check Setup](command:realtimeTex.checkSetup)

steps.title: Verify the bundled engine
steps.description:
The matching enhanced engine and support files are included in the installer. No upstream engine is downloaded.
[Verify bundled engine](command:realtimeTex.installRtex)

steps.title: Open the live preview
steps.description:
Open a `.tex` file and click the preview icon in the editor's top-right corner, or press **Cmd+Alt+V**.
[Open Live Preview](command:realtimeTex.openPreview)

steps.title: Jump between source and preview
steps.description: **Double-click** in the preview to jump to the source. **Double-click a word in the source** to reveal and highlight its preview line. Choose Single Click, Double Click, or Off from **Follow cursor**; press **Cmd+Alt+J** to jump on demand.

steps.title: Export a PDF
steps.description:
When you are done, export a PDF that matches a clean LuaLaTeX build.
[Export PDF](command:realtimeTex.exportPdf)
